description: This file defines LockService, which manages application lock state, PIN verification, biometric authentication, and auto-lock behavior in a Flutter app. It handles secure storage of salted PIN hashes and salts, biometric preferences, and reacts to app lifecycle events for auto-locking.

classes.name: LockService
classes.description: Manages application lock state, PIN, biometric authentication, and auto-lock logic for a Flutter application.

methods.name: isConfigured
methods.description: Checks if a PIN has been previously configured and stored securely.

methods.name: setPin
methods.description: Stores a new PIN by generating a salt, hashing the PIN with the salt, and saving both securely.

methods.name: verifyPin
methods.description: Verifies a provided PIN against the stored salted hash; unlocks if correct.

methods.name: enableBiometrics
methods.description: Sets user preference for biometric authentication.

methods.name: authenticateWithBiometrics
methods.description: Attempts biometric authentication to unlock the app.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Manually unlocks the application after successful authentication.

methods.name: observeLifecycle
methods.description: Handles app lifecycle changes to enforce auto-lock based on configured duration.
